2016–17 basketball game excitement

2016–17 basketball · Pregame inputs

Before Excitement Value (BEV) rates pregame appeal using CORS ranks and the projected margin. After Excitement Value (AEV) measures score-and-clock drama over two halves, with lead changes, comebacks and overtime. Both use a 0–100 scale. Six points is a two-possession margin. A pregame baseline uses the ratings available before tipoff.

* AEV estimated from the available scoring totals and comparable games. The score label identifies the available evidence.
